name: Fixed N=1 derivative-free finite-time sample chart existence

statement.note_ascii: the already-certified fixed-N=1 49-row shell-energy Taylor chart implies a 49-component derivative-free finite-time sample chart that is locally invertible for all sufficiently small nonzero sample spacings

definitions.phi_t: local analytic flow of the fixed finite N=1 polynomial Fourier-Galerkin ODE
definitions.S_h: 49-component shell-energy sample map: 24 samples of shell 0, 24 samples of shell 1 at times jh for j=0..23, plus shell 2 at time zero
definitions.c: product of the reordered 49-row Taylor-chart Jacobian determinant and the two 24x24 Vandermonde determinants

parents.evidence: the fixed-N=1 shell-energy Taylor chart has a certified nonsingular 49-row quotient Jacobian at the declared center
removes high-order numerical differentiation from the structural raw-time-sample observability interface while leaving explicit spacing, conditioning, noise and branch capture open

origin.source: Finite determinant/Vandermonde construction in github.com/morrocwi/readout-problem-navier-stokes/reproduction/NS_FINITE_SAMPLE_OBSERVABILITY_BRIDGE.md and checker check_volume7_eps19_n1_finite_sample_chart.py; reusable finite algebra in github.com/morrocwi/information-discrete-math/idm/finite_sample_chart.py; 2026-09-11.

claim_boundary: Fixed finite N=1, local and existential in sample spacing. It proves neither an explicit useful h nor branch-wide q_h<1, raw-sensor noise tolerance, branch selection, arbitrary-finite-N sample conditioning, continuum Navier-Stokes regularity, DNS adequacy, or the Clay Millennium problem. Proposal identifier only; weld code remains a placeholder pending canonical Toledo audit.
